style: Instrumental acoustic indie rock, warm and quietly hopeful, 94 BPM, 4/4, D major. Begin with an unplugged steel-string acoustic guitar alone, close wooden body, delicate fingerpicked open strings, alternating thumb and treble, a short falling original melody with rests. D major and G major seventh keep an open, sunlit sound. Bring restrained warm bass and soft acoustic drums under the acoustic picking. Hold back electric guitar until the late climax. A short quiet acoustic passage and held Asus4 resolve into a bright D-major return. At the late emotional peak a NEW chiming lightly overdriven electric guitar enters, long sustained notes and open octave answers, warm live bass and full cymbals; the original acoustic riff stays underneath. Finish with the quiet acoustic sound and a natural string decay. Instrumental performance, no vocals or vocalizations.
